description: Compare your numbers with a draw (the latest unless you give one). kr645 gives the rank and the prize per winner from the official record; powerball and megamillions give the match (prize amounts depend on state and multiplier and are not given). The answer is a drawstoday.com link where the result is shown; the answer itself carries no result.

extra_number.description: powerball: your Powerball 1-26. megamillions: your Mega Ball 1-24. Not used for kr645.

numbers.description: kr645: 6 numbers 1-45. powerball: 5 numbers 1-69. megamillions: 5 numbers 1-70.
